objective: From a leak-free six-domain clean UNSB baseline, run exactly four frozen seed-2026 lanes for 200 data epochs and freeze one current-best non-plain development candidate.
guarantees: a valid four-lane decision if engineering gates pass
one current-best candidate even if every delta is negative
traceable code, data, configuration, checkpoint and evaluation identities
non_guarantees: completion of the original 400-epoch UNSB schedule
change_policy: Any scientific change requires a committed replacement decision before any affected target metric is read.
